collection.description: Adults preparing a festival overlook a tiny ground nest that only a child notices.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Adults preparing a festival overlook a tiny ground nest that only (child) notices.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The decorations are moved and the eggs remain safe.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some adults feel embarrassed by the oversight.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) learns how to confirm a nest without touching it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The nest proves abandoned, but the caution was reasonable.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) becomes shy and requests an adult helper.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A few visitors complain until they understand why.
